title: Affine subtraction and scaling of a C^1 weak solution of a divergence-form system on an open set
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers. Notation: L := L(R^n, R^l), the continuous linear maps R^n -> R^l with the operator norm; L* := continuous linear forms on L; Bil := continuous bilinear forms on L, viewed as continuous linear maps L -> L*, written b[P][Q]. Df denotes the Frechet derivative (fderiv) of a map f; 'C^1_c map' means a C^1 map zeta : R^n -> R^l with compact support; integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure. Let Omega be an open subset of R^n (the set D of the Lean statement), b : R^n -> Bil, Theta : R^n -> L*, v : R^n -> R^l, B0 in Bil, Theta0 in L*, P0 in L, c in R^l and s real. Assume: (H1) the map (x, P, Q) -> b(x)[P][Q] is continuous on Omega x L x L; (H2) Theta is continuous on Omega; (H3) v is C^1 on Omega; (H4) for every C^1_c map zeta with tsupport zeta contained in Omega, the integral over Omega of b(x)[Dv(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over Omega of Theta(x)[Dzeta(x)]; (H5) for every C^1_c map zeta, the integrals over R^n of B0[P0][Dzeta(x)] and of Theta0[Dzeta(x)] are both 0. No integrability is assumed. Put V(x) := s (v(x) - c - P0 x). Then (i) V is C^1 on Omega; (ii) DV(x) = s (Dv(x) - P0) for every x in Omega; (iii) for every C^1_c map zeta with tsupport zeta contained in Omega, the integral over Omega of b(x)[DV(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over Omega of (s ((Theta(x) - Theta0) - (b(x)[P0] - B0[P0])))[Dzeta(x)], where b(x)[P0] and B0[P0] are the partial applications in L*.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (b : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Θ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (D : Set (Rn n)) (B₀ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Θ₀ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (P₀ : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (c : Rn ℓ) (s : ℝ), IsOpen D → ContinuousOn (fun p : Rn n × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) => b p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (D ×ˢ univ) → ContinuousOn Θ D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v D → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, b x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in D, Θ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, B₀ P₀ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, Θ₀ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => s • (v x - c - P₀ x)) D ∧ (∀ x ∈ D, fderiv ℝ (fun x => s • (v x - c - P₀ x)) x = s • (fderiv ℝ v x - P₀)) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, b x (fderiv ℝ (fun x => s • (v x - c - P₀ x)) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in D, (s • ((Θ x - Θ₀) - (b x P₀ - B₀ P₀))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
